title: Calendar Filter – Class Checkbox – SF Calendar – Class Checked – Calendar Shows Only Lessons With That Class
description: AC 02.1, BR-4 — Decision Table — Confirms that checking a class from the auto-populated list applies it as an active filter criterion and the SF Calendar shows only lessons containing that class.
preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- Course A has 3 classes: Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma
- Group lessons: G1 (Class Alpha), G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta), G3 (Class Beta), G4 (Class Gamma) in current week
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions: 1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter\n2. Check Class Alpha in the class filter\n3. Observe the calendar
steps_result: 1. Class section appears; Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma all unchecked\n2. Class Alpha checkbox is checked (active filter)\n3. Lesson G1 and Lesson G2 are shown; Lesson G3 and Lesson G4 are hidden
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Class Filter – Check and Uncheck

title: Calendar Filter – Class Checkbox – Class Unchecked After Being Checked – Calendar Reverts to All Course Lessons
description: AC 02.1, BR-5 — State Transition Testing — Confirms that unchecking a class removes it from the active filter and the calendar reverts to showing all lessons for the selected course.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- Course A has 3 classes; Group lessons G1–G4 exist in the current week\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A" and check Class Alpha
2. Uncheck Class Alpha
3. Observe the calendar
4. Confirm Course A is still selected in the Course filter
steps_result:
1. Calendar shows only Lesson G1 and Lesson G2 (containing Class Alpha)
2. Class Alpha checkbox returns to unchecked state
3. All 4 Course A lessons (G1, G2, G3, G4) are displayed again — no class filter active
4. "Course A – Introduction to Math" remains selected in the Course filter
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Class Filter – Check and Uncheck

title: Calendar Filter – Course and Class Independence – Class Unchecked – Course Filter Remains Selected
description: AC 02.1, BR-6 — Decision Table — Confirms that unchecking all class checkboxes does NOT deselect the course filter — the course filter remains active independently.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- "Course A" and "Course B" both have Group lessons on the calendar in the current week\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter
2. Check Class Alpha, then uncheck Class Alpha
3. Observe the Course filter section
4. Observe the calendar
steps_result:
1. Course A selected; class list appears; Course B lessons filtered out
2. Class Alpha is checked then unchecked; all classes now unchecked
3. "Course A – Introduction to Math" is still selected — it was NOT deselected
4. Only Course A lessons shown (course filter active); Course B lessons hidden; all 4 Course A lessons visible (no class filter)
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Class Filter – Check and Uncheck

title: Calendar Filter – Full Journey – Select Course, Check Two Classes, Uncheck One – Calendar State Correct at Each Step
description: AC 01.1 + AC 02.1 — State Transition Testing — End-to-end validation of the class filter state transitions: course selected → class appears unchecked → classes checked one-by-one → uncheck one → uncheck all → course persists.
preconditions:
- Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE
- "Course A" has 3 classes: Class Alpha, Class Beta, Class Gamma
- Group lessons: G1 (Class Alpha), G2 (Class Alpha+Class Beta), G3 (Class Beta), G4 (Class Gamma) in current week
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. Open SF Mana Calendar with no filter applied
2. Select "Course A – Introduction to Math" in the Course filter
3. Check Class Alpha
4. Also check Class Beta
5. Uncheck Class Beta
6. Uncheck Class Alpha
7. Confirm Course A is still selected in the Course filter
steps_result:
1. All 4 Course A lessons are visible on the calendar
2. Course A selected; Class section appears with all 3 classes unchecked; all 4 Course A lessons still visible
3. Class Alpha checked; calendar shows only Lesson G1 and Lesson G2
4. Both Class Alpha and Class Beta checked; calendar shows only Lesson G2 (AND logic)
5. Class Beta unchecked; Class Alpha still checked; calendar shows Lesson G1 and G2
6. All classes unchecked; calendar shows all 4 Course A lessons; Course A still selected
7. "Course A – Introduction to Math" remains selected; Class section still visible with all 3 classes unchecked
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Class Filter – Check and Uncheck
